<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/v1/containers/{id}/archive"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



When `path` is an existing directory, the archive is extracted into it. Otherwise it is
extracted into the parent with the archive's top-level entry renamed to the last element of
`path`. Every write stays inside the container; names starting with `.wh.` are ordinary files.
Ownership is taken from the archive.
